description: AC-09 corpus: 50 English lines dense in bilabials (M/B/P), for lip-sync accuracy (FR-LIP-06). Owner runs use generated, recorded and uploaded takes of these lines.
lines: Maybe we should begin with the basics.
Pass me the map before the boat leaves.
My brother bought a bright blue bike.
Please put the plates back by the bread.
Big bubbles burst above the bath.
Mum made pancakes for the whole family.
The plan was simple but nobody listened.
Bob probably knows a better path.
I promise the problem is temporary.
Keep the lamp by the window.
We met them at the museum in March.
Pick up the pieces and move on.
The puppy jumped into the puddle.
Bring a jumper, it might be cold.
Every member of the band played.
Paper, pens and a pair of scissors.
The baby smiled at the bumblebee.
Maps help when the mountain path bends.
Please be patient with my mistakes.
Both boys built a rope bridge.
Imagine a summer by the beach.
The problem begins with the budget.
Pour the milk before the mix sets.
My mobile phone battery is empty.
Mind the gap between the platform and the train.
A bumpy ride by bus to the market.
Members must bring their badges.
The happy campers sang by the fire.
Put the umbrella in the boot.
Pablo plays the piano beautifully.
Remember to bring the camera.
Bamboo bends but never breaks.
The pilot mapped a new approach.
Maybe the bakery opens at nine.
Bright beams of moonlight filled the room.
Plump plums sat in a purple bowl.
My boss emailed me a memo.
Bubble wrap protects the mirror.
The mob of pigeons scattered.
Pump up the ball before the match.
Brief messages beat long speeches.
Problems become puzzles with practice.
The baker built a ginger bread house.
Mabel bumped into a lamp post.
Please move the boxes upstairs.
Pink balloons popped at the party.
The museum maps were misprinted.
Babysitting became my summer job.
A big parade passed by the palace.
Somebody probably borrowed my umbrella.
